definitions.gloss: bereavement; parting by death; being separated by death
definitions.explanation: The experience of losing someone close through death. Focuses on the separation and loss felt by the surviving person.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{死別|しべつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十歳|じっさい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ときだった。
examples.english: I was ten years old when I lost my father.

examples.japanese: ⟦{愛|あい}する→愛する：01811_aisuru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死別|しべつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{深|ふか}い→深い：01211_fukai⟧⟦{悲|かな}しみ→悲しみ：05404_kanashimi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もたらす→もたらす：10546_motarasu⟧。
examples.english: The loss of a loved one brings deep sorrow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{配偶者|はいぐうしゃ}→配偶者：07430_haiguusha⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死別|しべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援する：25534_shiensuru⟧⟦グループ→グループ：03840_guruupu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There are support groups for people who have experienced the death of a spouse.

notes:
USAGE:
A formal, somewhat literary word used to describe the specific type of separation caused by someone's death. Takes ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ to mark the person one was separated from: ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{死別|しべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{死別|しべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to be parted from ~ by death)
- {死別|しべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{経験|けいけん}→経験：01179_keiken⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to experience bereavement)
- ⟦{親|おや}→親：01357_oya⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{死別|しべつ} (losing a parent to death)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {生|い}き{別|わか}れ: separation from a living person — being separated without death, typically due to circumstances
- ⟦{別離|べつり}→別離：20188_betsuri⟧: separation; parting — literary term for separation in general
